mapper.sql:
SELECT i.id, i.item_name, COALESCE(i.description, '') AS description, i.external_id, i.priority, i.start_date, i.due_date, i.sort_order, i.key_num, i.estimate_hours, i.progress, i.responded_at, i.resolved_at, i.recur_rule, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, , , , , p.id AS p_id, p.item_name AS p_item_name, p.key_num AS p_key_num, , , ,
FROM tb_item i JOIN tb_board b ON b.id = i.board_id JOIN tb_board_group g ON g.id = i.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_board_status s ON s.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN tb_board_duty d ON d.id = i.duty_id LEFT JOIN tb_item p ON p.id = i.parent_id LEFT JOIN tb_app_user a ON a.id = i.assignee_id LEFT JOIN tb_app_user c ON c.id = i.created_by LEFT JOIN tb_board_type t ON t.id = i.type_id LEFT JOIN tb_board_version v ON v.id = i.version_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tb_item WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_item SET updated_at = #{at}, responded_at = COALESCE(responded_at, #{respondedAt}) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WHERE i.id = #{id}
WHERE i.id IN #{x}
WHERE i.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id
WHERE i.parent_id IN #{x}
WHERE LOWER(i.item_name) LIKE #{pattern} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
WHERE i.due_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND i.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.is_done = false) AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE i.resolved_at IS NULL AND t.resolve_hours IS NOT NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.board_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_done = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done FROM tb_item i LEFT JOIN tb_board_status s ON s.id = i.status_id WHERE i.parent_id IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.board_id

SELECT i.id, i.group_id, i.duty_id, i.parent_id, i.item_name, i.status_id, i.assignee_id, a.username AS a_username, a.display_name AS a_name, a.department AS a_department, i.priority, i.start_date, i.due_date, i.sort_order, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.key_num, i.type_id, i.version_id, i.estimate_hours, i.progress, i.responded_at, i.resolved_at, i.recur_rule, i.created_by FROM tb_item i LEFT JOIN tb_app_user a ON a.id = i.assignee_id WHERE i.board_id = #{boardId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.id
SELECT id, item_name, board_id FROM tb_item WHERE id IN #{x}

SELECT i.id, i.item_name, g.group_name FROM tb_item i JOIN tb_board_group g ON g.id = i.group_id WHERE i.board_id = #{boardId} AND i.parent_id IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.sort_order, i.sort_order, i.id

AND (i.item_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR i.delete_reason ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR b.board_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id, i.item_name, i.key_num, i.parent_id, i.board_id, b.board_name, b.key_prefix, g.group_name, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, du.display_name AS deleted_by_name, i.delete_reason, cu.display_name AS created_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_item k WHERE k.parent_id = i.id AND k.deleted_at = i.deleted_at) AS child_count FROM tb_item i JOIN tb_board b ON b.id = i.board_id JOIN tb_board_group g ON g.id = i.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_app_user du ON du.id = i.deleted_by LEFT JOIN tb_app_user cu ON cu.id = i.created_by
ORDER BY i.deleted_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_item i JOIN tb_board b ON b.id = i.board_id
